caption: The drawing depicts a Victorian-era baby carriage centered against a plain, light beige background. The carriage consists of a red-brown body with a seat and a footrest, decorated with minimal black line detailing on the sides. It has three visible wheels: two large spoked wheels at the rear and one smaller spoked wheel at the front, all in matching red-brown tones with some shading for depth. Covering the back half of the carriage is a black canopy with a light brown or beige interior, which curves upward behind the seat. Two slender, slightly angled handles extend upward and backward from the sides of the carriage, each ending in a round wooden grip. The composition isolates the carriage against the neutral background, displaying the full form of the object with no additional elements present.
title: Baby Carriage
